text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
......Phew. Finished maintaining the horseshoes!
I think they turned out pretty great!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Not bad.
But I feel like I can make it even more precise.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It'll be fine! I should be able to finish
before midnight... hopefully!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, let's make the whole thing a bit sharper...
and redo the wax too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel got so absorbed in maintaining her horseshoes that she ended up staying up late...
